Copyright

Friday, 17/11/2023

Creative Commons Attribution

With the exception of the Commonwealth Coat of Arms, the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) logo, the Smartraveller logo, and any other material protected by trademark and where otherwise noted, all material presented on this site is provided under the latest Creative Commons Attribution licence.

The details of the relevant licence conditions and the full legal code for the licence are available on the Creative Commons website.

Content from this website should be attributed as the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade's Smartraveller website - www.smartraveller.gov.au.

Digital material terms of use

Digital material includes documents, images, video and audio.  

Digital material available for download should not be 

  • used for any commercial purposes such as marketing, advertising, brochures, sales materials or websites without prior written consent from DFAT 
  • altered or edited in any way other than what is needed to meet formatting requirements.  

Digital material available for download from this website cannot be used for political purposes or in a way contrary to DFAT’s apolitical standing. 

Photos of individuals available for download are only for publication when quoting the individual in a story. The photos may only be used in the publication of news or current affairs relating to DFAT.  

No permission is granted to use trademarks of DFAT apart from the incidental appearance of such trademarks in the material provided. 

Unless otherwise stated, all decorative background images, icons and illustrations on Smartraveller are copyrighted by their original owners and are not for reproduction. 

Use of the Coat of Arms

Guidelines for use of the Coat of Arms are published by the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet.

Use of Smartraveller Logo

The Smartraveller logo is owned by DFAT. Use of the logo without approval or in an inappropriate manner may result in legal action.

Travel industry partners and other organisations who would like to use the Smartraveller logo should send DFAT an email seeking permission.

Please include how the logo will be displayed and what format (PNG, JPG, EPS) you require and send your request to smartraveller@dfat.gov.au.

If you use the Smartraveller logo on your website, please link the image to the Smartraveller homepage: www.smartraveller.gov.au.

Third party copyright

Where a third party holds copyright in material presented on this website, the copyright remains with that party. Their permission may be required to use the material.



DFAT has made all reasonable efforts to clearly label material where the copyright is owned by a third party, and ensure that the copyright owner has consented to this material being presented on this website.

Copyright enquiries

For copyright enquiries, contact us.

Emergency consular assistance

The Australian Government provides 24-hour consular emergency assistance.

+61 2 6261 3305 from overseas

1300 555 135 from within Australia

For how we can help you overseas see the Consular Services Charter.

Enquiries and feedback

For non-urgent enquiries, or to provide feedback on consular services that you've recently received, contact us online.

For information on notarial services, email legalisations.australia@dfat.gov.au

To report a vulnerability you’ve identified on this website or to find out more about the department’s Vulnerability Disclosure Policy visit the DFAT website
